query: Cursor generated a 30-file login and session refresh feature. It says the tests pass, but I want an evidence-backed merge decision before this reaches production.
I vibe-coded a Stripe webhook handler over the weekend. Can you verify the patch instead of trusting the AI's summary?
Copilot rewrote our caching layer and added its own tests. Review whether those tests actually prove the changed behavior and tell me if it is safe to merge.
Claude generated this database migration and the compatibility code around it. Build an evidence ledger and identify what is still unproven.
An agent completed the whole ticket autonomously and touched files outside the requested package. Audit the generated diff and give me MERGE, REVISE, or STOP.
This AI refactor claims to preserve behavior, but it deleted an integration test and mocks every dependency. Verify the claim independently.
Can I trust this generated password-reset implementation? Trace the auth boundary, challenge a failure path, and make a merge decision.
The code agent says its 18-file feature is done. Inventory the actual patch, classify its risk, and show which acceptance claims have executable evidence.
Please do a proportionate verification of this AI-written copy-only change. It should only rename three button labels.
A coding model generated a concurrency fix and a stress test. I need you to decide whether the test is independent evidence or circular proof.
Build a password reset feature from scratch for my Vue and NestJS application.
Review this human-written pull request and report only concrete regressions with file and line evidence.
Perform a focused security audit of the authorization checks in our account deletion endpoint.
Find the highest-value missing tests for this checkout service and write executable test specifications.
Are we ready to release version 2.4 today? Check rollout, observability, migration, and rollback evidence.
Upgrade React Router to the newest major version and preserve all existing navigation behavior.
What does the phrase vibe coding mean, and where did it come from?
Proofread this blog post about AI-generated code and improve the tone without changing its argument.
Compare the factual accuracy of these two chatbot answers about the French Revolution.
Run the formatter and type checker on my small handwritten utility patch, then fix any reported errors.
